drivingQuestion: What does the doubled 'I will be' say to Israel, and should the second half be told them?
outcomeNote: Moses' objection is accepted — the biur says explicitly that God agreed with him — and the message to Israel is shortened to 'I will be has sent me to you'.

segments.he: ״אֶהְיֶה אֲשֶׁר אֶהְיֶה״, אָמַר לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְמֹשֶׁה, לֵךְ אֱמוֹר לָהֶם לְיִשְׂרָאֵל: אֲנִי הָיִיתִי עִמָּכֶם בְּשִׁעְבּוּד זֶה, וַאֲנִי אֶהְיֶה עִמָּכֶם בְּשִׁעְבּוּד מַלְכֻיוֹת.
segments.en: The Gemara proceeds to discuss the promise of redemption from Egypt that God made to Moses at the burning bush. When Moses asked God what to say when Israel asks him God’s name, “and God said to Moses: «‘I will be that I will be,’» and He said: ‘Thus you will say unto the children of Israel: I will be has sent me to you’” (Exodus 3:14). «The Holy One, Blessed be He, told» Moses «to go and tell Israel: I was with you in this enslavement,» and in this redemption, «and I will be with you in the enslavement of the kingdoms» in the future.

segments.he: אָמַר לְפָנָיו: רִבּוֹנוֹ שֶׁל עוֹלָם, דַּיָּה לַצָּרָה בִּשְׁעָתָהּ. אָמַר לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא: לֵךְ אֱמוֹר לָהֶם ״אֶהְיֶה שְׁלָחַנִי אֲלֵיכֶם״.
segments.en: Moses «said before Him: Master of the Universe, it is enough» for them to endure. Let «the» future «suffering» be endured «at its» appointed «time.» There is no need to mention their future enslavement. «The Holy One, Blessed be He,» agreed with Moses and «said to him: Go and tell» the children of Israel only that, «“I will be has sent me to you.”»

moves.summary: takes up the promise of redemption given to Moses at the bush, in the run of exodus expositions
moves.about: quoting God's doubled answer at the burning bush as the lemma

moves.cueHe: אמר לו הקדוש ברוך הוא למשה, לך אמור להם לישראל
moves.summary: the doubling is a message: I am with you now and under the kingdoms to come
moves.about: sending him to tell Israel that God is with them in this enslavement and in the subjugations to come

moves.cueHe: אמר לפניו: רבונו של עולם, דיה לצרה בשעתה
moves.summary: Moses objects that the future trouble need not be mentioned now
moves.about: whether Israel should be told now of the subjugations still to come — it is enough for trouble to be borne in its own time

moves.cueHe: אמר לו הקדוש ברוך הוא: לך אמור להם ״אהיה שלחני אליכם״
moves.summary: God accepts and shortens the message
moves.about: accepting Moses' objection, so that Israel are told only 'I will be has sent me to you'
